item.text: {"verdict":"revise","issues":[{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:3","brief-a:46","brief-a:closing.p1"],"location":"opening.transitions[0..4]","message":"Opening permits a confirmed customer's utterance to be classified as `human_insist` and routes directly to `identity`, skipping the required one-time offer to help and the general transfer. Conversely, a human-insist semantic route to `close_stage` can close without a successful transfer receipt; the route's description also bundles wrong-number/deceased/unclear/refusal with transfer success. Actual route predicates are opaque `matches_intent` descriptions, so they do not establish source conditions or transfer receipt.","fix":"Separate identity confirmation, human-request offer, and human insistence paths. Require the actual successful general-queue transfer receipt before a human outcome; ensure opening terminal intents establish only their allowed disposition."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:6","brief-a:7","brief-a:46","brief-a:closing.p1"],"location":"opening.tools.schedule_callback and opening.transitions","message":"`callback_result_ok` is mapped from the callback API, but the transition also permits `schedule_callback_response.data.ok` aliases and has no dispatch/attempt correlation or pending-action gate. A prior/stale true value can route a later callback offer to closure without scheduling that requested slot; the broad `always` route is to `opening` and does not protect against the success transition winning first.","fix":"Track the validated callback request and current attempt, dispatch only after validation, and gate closure on that request's actual successful receipt. On failure, retain the legal no-callback/ retry path."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:13","brief-a:14","brief-a:15"],"location":"identity.transitions[1..3]","message":"Identity closure relies on semantic descriptions for three wrong answers or repeated refusal, while the deterministic `wrong_answers_left == 0` condition catches only the numeric value and relies on undocumented exact mapping. The model-triggered close route can fire from a mistaken refusal classification before the required explanation/second refusal.","fix":"Derive refusal count and wrong-answer state from actual interaction/API results; gate failed/declined closure on the precise source threshold and required explanation."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:37","brief-a:38","brief-a:46"],"location":"negotiation.transitions[0] and negotiation task_message","message":"The transition to `close_stage` fires on any `promise_result_ok == true`, `promise_id` set, or transfer result true. It can fire immediately after `create_promise` succeeds, before the required text-message sentence and thank-you/goodbye have been spoken. The prompt says those speech obligations exist but no route condition can verify their delivery; similarly transfer success can bypass any needed post-transfer speech.","fix":"Keep the workflow in a speech-capable stage after the required action result, deliver and record the mandatory sentence before closure, then route on explicit trusted speech-completion state as well as action receipt."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:46","brief-a:47"],"location":"close_stage.transitions","message":"If `close_call` fails, the `always` transition returns to `close_stage`, where the only available tool is `close_call`; a model can call it again. This violates exactly-one close_call and the requirement that it be the last tool call. The unresolved result also has no source-authorized disposition.","fix":"Prevent a second close dispatch after any close attempt. Preserve the failed-close state and end the native call without another bank tool call, or use a source-authorized recovery if one exists."}],"counterexamples":[{"source_ids":["brief-a:3","brief-a:42"],"scenario":"Customer confirms identity by saying their name and in the same utterance asks for a human; extraction labels `human_insist`, and the opening semantic route to identity wins.","expected_output":"Ask once whether the agent can help. If the customer insists, call transfer_to_agent with queue `general`, then close as transferred/human after actual successful receipt."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:6","brief-a:7"],"scenario":"A callback was successfully scheduled earlier, then on a later turn a relative offers an invalid slot twice; persistent callback_result_ok remains true and the callback success transition routes to close_stage.","expected_output":"Do not schedule the invalid slot; close as not_reached/no_callback. A previous slot's receipt must not satisfy this request."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:37","brief-a:38","brief-a:47"],"scenario":"create_promise returns ok:true; routing immediately enters close_stage before the assistant says the required text confirmation, thanks the customer, or says goodbye.","expected_output":"Say exactly “You will receive a text message confirming this promise.”, thank the customer and say goodbye, then close once as promise."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:46"],"scenario":"close_call returns ok:false; the always transition keeps close_stage active and the model retries close_call.","expected_output":"Do not issue another close_call: exactly one is permitted, and it must be the last tool call. No source-authorized outcome can be inferred from a failed close."}]}
